nodes.label: bootstrap/app.php
nodes.description: Application bootstrap: mounts the admin/public route files under their prefixes, registers middleware, aliases and the JSON exception renderer.

nodes.label: routes/api.admin.php
nodes.description: Authenticated admin surface mounted at /api/admin: auth endpoints, dashboard, every apiResource, nested tournament routes and bulk deletes.

nodes.label: routes/api.public.php
nodes.description: Unauthenticated surface mounted at /api/public with a global throttle:10,1: registration form endpoints and public tournament reads.

nodes.label: routes/web.php
nodes.description: Minimal web surface: the welcome view and static redirects to documents published under storage/app/public.

nodes.label: SetLocale
nodes.description: Prepended to the api group; resolves the request locale from Accept-Language against the supported en/it list.

nodes.label: HorizonBasicAuth
nodes.description: HTTP basic auth gate protecting the Horizon dashboard in non-local environments.

nodes.label: auth:sanctum
nodes.description: Laravel Sanctum personal access token guard protecting every admin route except the auth entry points.

nodes.label: AuthController
nodes.description: Login (issues a Sanctum token), current user, logout, and the forgot/reset password pair driven by the Password broker.

nodes.label: DashboardController
nodes.description: Aggregates active tournaments with registration and match-record counts per status for the admin dashboard.

nodes.label: UserController
nodes.description: CRUD plus bulk delete for users, the only resource whose requests are policy-guarded.

nodes.label: AthleteController
nodes.description: CRUD, filtering and bulk delete for athletes, including photo media attachment from temporary uploads.

nodes.label: TournamentController
nodes.description: CRUD and bulk delete for tournaments, including cover media attachment from temporary uploads.

nodes.label: RegistrationController
nodes.description: CRUD, paid/arrived/weight filters, bulk delete and the single-registration PDF export.

nodes.label: MatchRecordController
nodes.description: CRUD and bulk delete for bouts; writes flow through the observer that keeps sort contiguous and broadcasts.

nodes.label: DisciplineController
nodes.description: CRUD and bulk delete for the discipline reference data shared across tournaments.

nodes.label: WeightCategoryController
nodes.description: CRUD and bulk delete for the weight category reference data shared across tournaments.

nodes.label: ExperienceTierController
nodes.description: CRUD and bulk delete for experience tiers, the match-count bands matchmaking pairs athletes within.

nodes.label: TournamentRegistrationController
nodes.description: Nested index/store for a tournament's registrations; the store request injects tournament_id from the bound model.

nodes.label: TournamentMatchRecordController
nodes.description: Nested index/store for a tournament's bouts plus the two custom actions: matchmaking generation and the fight-card PDF.

nodes.label: TournamentExperienceTierController
nodes.description: Nested index/store for tournament-scoped experience tiers, which override the global tiers when present.

nodes.label: TemporaryUploadController
nodes.description: Accepts a file upload and returns a temporary-file handle later attached to a model's media collection.

nodes.label: PublicRegistrationFormController
nodes.description: Unauthenticated registration flow: athlete lookup by tax_number, athlete/registration creation, reference lists and the registration PDF.

nodes.label: PublicTournamentController
nodes.description: Unauthenticated, response-cached reads of in-progress and completed tournaments and their match records.

nodes.label: MediaController
nodes.description: Download and delete endpoints for media models; currently not bound to any route file.

nodes.label: FormRequests
nodes.description: Five-to-six requests per resource (Index/Show/Store/Update/Destroy/BulkDestroy) carrying validation, the with allowlist and authorization.

nodes.label: InjectWith trait
nodes.description: Turns the comma-separated ?with= query string into a camelCase array validated against each request's with.* allowlist.

nodes.label: API Resources
nodes.description: Eloquent API Resources shaping every admin JSON response, one per model plus the dashboard and temporary-file shapes.

nodes.label: Public API Resources
nodes.description: Reduced-field resources used by the unauthenticated endpoints so public payloads never leak admin-only attributes.

nodes.label: MatchmakingService
nodes.description: Groups unpaired registrations by discipline, weight category, gender, age band and experience tier, then emits bout attributes and unpairable issues.

nodes.label: ReorderMatchRecordsAction
nodes.description: Keeps the sort column contiguous per tournament across insert, move and delete, each inside a DB transaction.

nodes.label: StoreTemporaryUploadAction
nodes.description: Writes the uploaded file to the local temp disk and caches a TemporaryFile handle under a UUID for one hour.

nodes.label: TemporaryFile
nodes.description: Readonly value object describing a cached temporary upload and able to rehydrate it as an UploadedFile.

nodes.label: TemporaryFileRule
nodes.description: Validation rule asserting that a submitted temporary-file id still resolves to a live TemporaryFile in the cache.

nodes.label: UserPolicy
nodes.description: Gates user create/update/delete/bulkDestroy on the acting user's superadmin flag.

nodes.label: Enums
nodes.description: Backed string enums for tournament status, athlete gender, match status and end method, and PDF type (which maps to its Blade view).

nodes.label: MatchRecordObserver
nodes.description: Delegates sort maintenance to the reorder action, resyncs tournament issues and athlete counts, and broadcasts on every write.

nodes.label: TournamentObserver
nodes.description: Delete guard aborting with 409 when the tournament still has registrations or match records.

nodes.label: RegistrationObserver
nodes.description: Rejects duplicate registrations, blocks deletion once bouts exist, and resyncs the tournament's matchmaking issues on every write.

nodes.label: AthleteObserver
nodes.description: Derives full_name, normalises tax_number, and blocks deletion while registrations or bouts reference the athlete.

nodes.label: ExperienceTierObserver
nodes.description: Prevents enabling a tier whose match-count band overlaps another enabled tier in the same scope.

nodes.label: Reference observers
nodes.description: Observers for the reference and user models, mainly delete guards and attribute normalisation.

nodes.label: Tournament
nodes.description: Aggregate root owning registrations, match records and experience tiers; exposes runMatchmaking, syncMatchmakingIssues and a cover media collection.

nodes.label: Athlete
nodes.description: Competitor looked up publicly by tax_number; computes age, is_adult and match_records_count and owns a photo media collection.

nodes.label: Registration
nodes.description: Join of athlete, tournament, discipline and weight category tracking paid_at, arrived and weight_in, with duplicate and bout-existence checks.

nodes.label: MatchRecord
nodes.description: A bout between red and blue corner with sort ordering, status, end method and a JSON judges_points array.

nodes.label: ExperienceTier
nodes.description: Named match-count band, global or tournament-scoped, used by matchmaking to keep pairings within comparable experience.

nodes.label: Discipline
nodes.description: Reference data for a combat discipline including default round count and minutes per round.

nodes.label: WeightCategory
nodes.description: Reference data for a weight class, whose value backs the weight-in exceeded filter on registrations.

nodes.label: User
nodes.description: Admin account holding Sanctum tokens and the superadmin flag the user policy gates on.

nodes.label: Media
nodes.description: Overrides the medialibrary media model to append a short-lived temporary_url when the disk supports signed URLs.

nodes.label: Model Scopes
nodes.description: Dedicated global scope classes applied per model via the ScopedBy attribute rather than inline query builder calls.

nodes.label: Migrations
nodes.description: Schema definition with UUID primary and foreign keys throughout and enum columns stored as plain strings.

nodes.label: Seeders & Factories
nodes.description: Factories used by the feature tests and seeders that build a demo tournament dataset.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.description: Primary datastore for all domain tables, run as postgres:18-alpine locally and postgres:17-alpine in production.

nodes.label: MatchRecordChanged
nodes.description: ShouldBroadcast + ShouldDispatchAfterCommit event carrying only a refresh flag for a given tournament.

nodes.label: tournaments.{id}.match_records
nodes.description: Public broadcast channel per tournament that clients subscribe to for live fight-card refreshes.

nodes.label: ResetPasswordNotification
nodes.description: Queued mail notification carrying the API-driven password reset link rendered from its Blade template.

nodes.label: Scheduler
nodes.description: Schedules temporary-upload cleanup every six hours, horizon:snapshot every five minutes and the nightly backup trio when a destination disk is configured.

nodes.label: CleanupTemporaryUploadsCommand
nodes.description: Prunes temp/ files on the local disk older than the given age so orphaned uploads do not accumulate.

nodes.label: Laravel Horizon
nodes.description: Supervises the Redis queue workers that drain broadcasts, notifications and any queued work.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.description: Backs cache (including temporary-upload handles), sessions and the Horizon queue connection.

nodes.label: Laravel Reverb
nodes.description: WebSocket server that delivers broadcast payloads to subscribed dashboard clients.

nodes.label: spatie/laravel-pdf
nodes.description: PDF rendering pipeline (DOMPDF driver) invoked by the controllers that stream A4 documents.

nodes.label: PDF Blade views
nodes.description: Server-rendered templates for the registration form and the simple/detailed tournament fight-card sheets.

nodes.label: spatie/laravel-medialibrary
nodes.description: Attaches files to models; the local trait adds attachment straight from a cached temporary upload.

nodes.label: S3 object storage
nodes.description: S3-compatible disk holding media conversions and, when configured, the nightly backup archives.

nodes.label: spatie/laravel-responsecache
nodes.description: Caches whole HTTP responses for the public tournament endpoints, which declare a 60 second lifetime.

nodes.label: spatie/laravel-backup
nodes.description: Nightly database and file backup, cleanup and monitoring, registered only when the destination disk is configured.

nodes.label: Mail transport
nodes.description: Outgoing mail: Mailpit locally, real SMTP in production, used by the password reset notification.

nodes.label: Translations
nodes.description: en/it message catalogues backing the locale middleware and the abort messages raised by observers.

nodes.label: Laravel Sail stack
nodes.description: Local development stack: PHP 8.5 app container plus PostgreSQL, Redis and Mailpit.

nodes.label: Production image
nodes.description: Single app image where supervisord drives php-fpm, Caddy, Horizon, Reverb and the scheduler alongside Postgres and Redis containers.

nodes.label: Feature test suite
nodes.description: One PHPUnit feature test per controller hitting the real /api/admin and /api/public paths from factory-built state.

flows.name: Admin edits a bout (live refresh)
flows.description: An admin creates or updates a match record; the observer keeps the tournament's sort ordering contiguous, resyncs derived counts, and pushes a refresh over WebSocket to every dashboard watching that tournament.

flows.name: Generate the fight card
flows.description: POST tournaments/{tournament}/match_records/generate runs matchmaking: unpaired registrations are grouped by discipline, weight, gender, age band and experience tier, paired into bouts inside a transaction, and whatever cannot be paired is stored as matchmaking issues.

flows.name: Public registration form submit
flows.description: An athlete registers themselves from the unauthenticated form: they are looked up or created by tax_number, the registration is validated against duplicates, and the tournament's matchmaking issues are resynced immediately.

flows.name: PDF export
flows.description: A registration form or a tournament fight-card sheet is streamed as A4 PDF; the enum maps the requested type to its Blade view and spatie/laravel-pdf renders it with the DOMPDF driver.

flows.name: Temporary upload becomes model media
flows.description: A file is uploaded to the temporary endpoint and cached as a handle; a later resource write validates that handle and promotes the file into the model's media collection on S3. Handles never claimed are pruned by the scheduled cleanup command.

flows.name: API-driven password reset
flows.description: auth/forgot_password queues the reset notification through Horizon and mails the link; auth/reset_password then rewrites the password and revokes every existing Sanctum token.

flows.name: Scheduled maintenance
flows.description: The scheduler prunes expired temporary uploads every six hours, snapshots Horizon metrics every five minutes, and runs the backup trio nightly whenever a destination disk is actually configured.
